result: MissionCanvasProjectionController now consumes the generated MissionCanvasClient.projectionGet boundary (while retaining the existing narrow loader seam), validates the generated ResolvedWorkspaceProjection and exact Workstream authority, rejects stale projection/layout/cursor watermarks, and exposes only fail-closed projection state to the Desktop renderer.

presentation_contract.surface_kind: Focusa Desktop Mission Canvas Svelte GUI tab
continuity_invariants: Desktop cannot mint or repair authority
stale responses cannot replace an accepted projection
Core remains the eligibility and layout composition owner

dependency_gate.UI-001: integrated generated transport adapter present in apps/desktop
dependency_gate.UI-002: verified Desktop exact Workstream context source present
dependency_gate.CONTRACT-006: integrated generated validator source consumed without editing generated artifacts

implementation: The controller accepts a generated MissionCanvasClient-shaped source and invokes projectionGet with a detached exact WorkstreamAuthorityContext; it does not fetch, resolve candidates, infer profiles, or repair scope locally.

validateProjection delegates DTO validation to the checked-in generated validator, then defensively validates exact top-level and nested contribution authority, projection watermarks, cursor namespace, and layout references before any projection can reach Svelte.
rejectStaleRevision rejects projection revision, layout revision, durable cursor regressions, invalid watermarks, and cursor namespace changes without replacing the prior canonical projection.

Scope changes increment the request generation; late responses from a prior Workstream are ignored, foreign current responses become blocked, malformed responses become error/stale, and clear invalidates in-flight work.

Accepted scope and projection values are detached and deeply frozen so caller or transport mutation cannot change Desktop state. Core-owned empty/ineligible contributions remain omitted and are never synthesized by the controller.

npm --prefix apps/desktop run check (exit 0; svelte-check: 0 errors, 0 warnings)

negative_cases.missing_workstream: A malformed Desktop context is blocked before projectionGet and no transport call is made.
negative_cases.foreign_workstream: A response for another Workstream becomes blocked and cannot enter ready state.
negative_cases.foreign_nested_authority: A contribution with foreign Workstream or subordinate authority becomes blocked.
negative_cases.stale_projection_revision: A lower projection revision preserves the accepted projection and enters stale state.
negative_cases.stale_layout_revision: A lower layout revision preserves the accepted projection and enters stale state.
negative_cases.stale_cursor: A lower same-namespace cursor or a different cursor namespace is rejected fail-closed.
negative_cases.invalid_response: Missing schema/arrays, malformed contributions, invalid focus authority, malformed layout, duplicate layout references, and unknown layout contribution IDs cannot reach the renderer.
negative_cases.late_prior_workstream_response: A response resolving after a newer Workstream request is ignored by request generation and cannot overwrite the newer loading/ready state.
negative_cases.clear_during_load: clear() invalidates the request generation and leaves the controller unbound after a late response.
negative_cases.empty_or_ineligible_contribution: The valid fixture retains Core omission diagnostics for the empty Work Rail and does not add a replacement panel or layout node.
negative_cases.mutable_input_output: Caller and transport mutations after handoff do not mutate the frozen Desktop scope or projection.

acceptance: A response for another Workstream or older revision cannot enter ready state.
Desktop selection cannot mint or repair authority.
Stale responses from a prior Workstream or projection revision are rejected or ignored fail-closed.
The renderer receives only a generated, exact-scope ResolvedWorkspaceProjection and no mock canonical content.
Core-owned eligibility and adaptive composition are consumed as canonical output rather than recomputed in Svelte.
